def: to pinch, i.e. (partially) to bite the lips, blink the eyes (as a gesture of malice), or (fully) to squeeze off (a piece of clay in order to mould a vessel from it)

words.word: in gods stead i also am formed
over me neither let them wink

occurrences.text: Behold, I am according to thy wish in God’s stead: I also am formed out of the clay.
words: in Gods stead I also am formed

occurrences.text: Let not them that are mine enemies wrongfully rejoice over me: neither let them wink with the eye that hate me without a cause.
words: over me neither let them wink

occurrences.text: He winketh with his eyes, he speaketh with his feet, he teacheth with his fingers;
He that winketh with the eye causeth sorrow: but a prating fool shall fall.
He shutteth his eyes to devise froward things: moving his lips he bringeth evil to pass.
